body:
Raised: 2026-10-03 UTC. Moderator finding on PR #610, merge `39188aadf6efdae60357d9d4a1bbb62ffd981003`; source packet #485, regional integration #488. Related pattern: #605 covers a different owned packet (#486), so it cannot fix this directory.

In `data/regional-review/regional-review-4254da254d94f450/extract_baseline.py`, lines 9–19 read current world parts, membership inventory and hierarchy, but do not verify the assigned hierarchy/footprint/macro/frozen-scope pins before lines 34/37 overwrite the retained baseline extracts. Matching 222 IDs does not verify their geometry or parent meaning. Both writes use `gzip.open(...,'wb',compresslevel=9)`, embedding the current timestamp; rerunning unchanged inputs changes compressed SHA-256 values. Line 39 refreshes the baseline receipt while `sources-manifest.json` retains the original compressed hashes. This makes the saved extraction routine unsafe to reuse and breaks provenance consistency. Static code/receipt review only; the moderator did not execute it or verify binary source bytes.

One focused reproduction/provenance correction within this packet. Coordinate with the original owner before reserving the directory. Preserve original extracts, hashes, source bytes, all 222 stable IDs and historical records. Validate the assigned baseline before any overwrite; a changed baseline must fail closed. Preserve original artifacts and reproduce them with their recorded compression metadata, or write separately identified deterministic artifacts with canonical uncompressed hashes and retain originals. Keep receipts and source manifest consistent, and document which commands use immutable retained inputs. Include a meaningful two-run reproducibility check and changed-baseline rejection check.

No shared geography, grid, application, database, live release or approval changes. Completing this item does not approve the region or authorize imports. Coordinator must review dependencies/ownership before readiness.
